incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT fired: PD#847362 - routing-proxy-5xx-rate high (group: routing)
pagerduty: PagerDuty note: Escalation to on-call (primary) — please ack
Casey: acked — I'm on it :raising_hand:
Mira: oncall-responder I'm nearby if you need backup
Casey: quick check — dashboards show a 5xx spike from the north-eu edge pool, ~2.3k reqs/min at peak, lasted ~3m
Casey: running query on metrics
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="routing-proxy",status=~"5..",region="eu-north"}[1m]))
```
Oliver: FYI autoscaler briefly spun up 2 extra pods at 12:04 UTC then went back down
Casey: logs show a few upstream connection errors, then NACK floods from the upstream loadbalancer
Casey: snippet from proxy logs:
```
[12:03:59] WARN connect fail to upstream-19: context deadline exceeded
[12:04:01] ERROR upstream NACK x12 requests
```
SRE-Leah: any customer-facing errors? support slack quiet so far
Casey: checked error budget pages and external SLOs — no client errors increased, only internal 5xx for a subset of short requests
oncall-responder: rolled a quick BGP route check, nothing obvious
Mira: can we temporarily route eu-north traffic to eu-central as fallback? low-risk path
Casey: traffic re-routing would require a config flip, but we can try a targeted node drain on the affected edge hosts first
Oliver: launching a quick drain on edge-host-17 to test — will cordon then watch
Casey: drain started 12:05:10 UTC
SRE-Leah: adding a short alert annotation: possible transient LB jitter causing NACK spikes
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD#847362 acknowledged by Casey
pagerduty: PagerDuty update: alert auto-resolved (trigger cleared) at 12:07:34 UTC
Casey: looks like the drain cleared the backlog, 5xx rate dropped back to baseline within ~90s
Casey: confirmed no customer-facing impact in the last 15m
Mira: nice — short burst, likely an upstream LB flake. Do we want a follow-up ticket to tune probe retries / backoff?
Casey: yes, I'll create a follow-up in #eng-runtime issues. Tentative title: "edge LB NACK bursts — probe/backoff tuning"
Oliver: adding suggested metrics to capture in the ticket: `nack_rate`, `upstream_conn_fail`, `active_connections` per edge host
SRE-Leah: recommend we add a narrow suppression rule for this specific `routing-proxy` transient pattern so PD noise is reduced, but keep severity for sustained spikes
Casey: +1 to suppression with a short debounce window (2m) and escalate if >5m
oncall-responder: handoff: I'll leave monitoring on for the next 30m. If it flares, escalate to Leah
Mira: thanks, team. no customer impact, PD auto-resolved. filing the ticket now.
Casey: quick incident note for postmortem: root cause unknown, probable upstream LB flake + transient NACK amplification; mitigation was targeted drain of affected edge host which recovered traffic within ~2m
incident-bot: PD#847362 closed (auto-resolved) — thread archived
Mira: :thumbsup: good catch, tidy handoff
Casey: closing thread — will link ticket here once created
